answer: For a poll on displaying a lotus mural bearing a whisper cipher, each application needs a distinct sponsor’s $10 bond. Officials check bonds and refuse missing or reused ones. They randomly audit applications against the issuing registry, removing invalid audited applications and forfeiting their sponsors’ bonds; all other bonds are returned. Each extra application ties up $10 and risks forfeiture. Unaudited invalid IDs can pass, and valid IDs need not represent distinct applicants.
